sql: WITH SeniorityMedian AS (SELECT seniority, mart_comp_by_family.p50 AS median_pay FROM mart_comp_by_family WHERE family IS NULL AND seniority IS NOT NULL), OverallMedian AS (SELECT p50 AS overall_median_pay FROM mart_comp_by_family WHERE family IS NULL AND seniority IS NULL) SELECT sm.seniority, sm.median_pay, (sm.median_pay - om.overall_median_pay) AS difference_from_overall FROM SeniorityMedian sm, OverallMedian om ORDER BY sm.median_pay DESC
